description: Required core stop behavior. Except where stated otherwise, messages are verified, authorized, structurally valid, and processed within a retained live context. S and N identify fresh opening say messages; T identifies a stop message whose required turn field names its intended opening request. These abstract traces require semantic checking and do not establish implementation conformance, restart durability, or application cancellation guarantees. Unless a step states otherwise, conversation traffic uses an explicitly selected applicable continuity profile with valid authorized guards and retained required context at admission; stale traffic from an ended scope is rejected at that boundary before ordinary correlation or disposition handling.

cases.name: stop closes only its identified open turn

steps.event: S is open with unanswered question Q; independent approval A is pending in the same conversation
stop T with turn S is accepted
expect: ack T
one result naming S with status stopped
Q closes as withdrawn
A is not implicitly closed by stopping S
no further advancement of S

steps.event: an obsolete internal computation for S completes
expect: no second terminal result for S
no success replacing its stopped result

cases.name: a delayed stop cannot close a newer turn

steps.event: S is open; the requester sends stop T with turn S; transport delays T
S completes with result R; the requester explicitly releases T's unconfirmed sending slot; N opens
T arrives
expect: refusal nothing-to-stop for T
N remains open
R remains S's sole terminal result

cases.name: a duplicate accepted stop cannot close a newer turn

steps.event: T with turn S is accepted; S closes with result R as stopped
N opens after the relevant sending slots are released
an identical copy of T arrives
expect: duplicate acknowledgement for T
no repeated handling of T
N remains open
no second result for S

steps.event: a new stop U with turn S arrives
expect: refusal nothing-to-stop for U
N remains open

cases.name: prospective suppression does not stop an unrelated open turn

steps.event: N is open; fresh opening request S is delayed and unknown in this context
T with turn S is accepted
expect: ack T
retain suppression for opening request S from this asker in this conversation
N remains open
no result for S because no turn S opened

steps.event: valid fresh say S arrives without in_response_to
expect: ack S
taken for S as not-acted-on without turn
no work starts for S
N remains open

cases.name: known non-opening targets are malformed

steps.event: S is open; C is an admitted contribution; Q is S's question; R is the result of a different closed turn
T names C in turn
expect: refusal malformed for T
no inferred retargeting from C to S
S remains open

steps.event: new stop U names Q in turn
expect: refusal malformed for U
Q remains open
S remains open

steps.event: new stop V names R in turn
expect: refusal malformed for V
no inferred retargeting from R to its turn
S remains open

cases.name: a known target from another context cannot be stopped here

steps.event: N is open; the receiver knows that S is a fresh request from another asker or in another conversation
otherwise authorized stop T addresses N's conversation with turn S
expect: refusal malformed for T
no effect on S or N
no cross-conversation authority inferred from the reference

cases.name: a known fresh request that did not open a turn has nothing to stop

steps.event: N is open; fresh request S was accepted as not-acted-on
T arrives with turn S
expect: refusal nothing-to-stop for T
N remains open
S's established not-acted-on disposition is unchanged

cases.name: a prospective target cannot suppress a later contribution

steps.event: S is open and permits contributions; no message C is known in this context
T with turn C is accepted
expect: ack T
prospective suppression is limited to a fresh opening request C
S remains open

steps.event: C arrives as a valid say with in_response_to S
expect: normal contribution admission under S's contract
ack C
taken for C as added-to-turn with turn S
no suppression of C as an opening request
no implicit stop of S

steps.event: new stop U with turn C arrives
expect: refusal malformed for U because C is now known as a contribution
S remains open

cases.name: a suppression marker is not a turn or an opening message

steps.event: T with turn S is accepted while S is unknown
contribution C arrives with in_response_to S before opening request S
expect: refusal unknown for C
the suppression marker does not reconstruct S or establish its response contract

steps.event: fresh opening request S arrives
expect: ack S
taken for S as not-acted-on
no turn opens and no result is owed for S

steps.event: new contribution D arrives with in_response_to S
expect: refusal malformed for D because S did not open a turn
no reopening or execution of S

cases.name: stop acceptance precedes later contributions and answers

steps.event: S is open with question Q; contribution C naming S and answer A naming Q are delayed
T with turn S is accepted
expect: ack T
S closes as stopped
Q closes as withdrawn

steps.event: C and A arrive for the first time
expect: refusal closed for C
refusal closed for A
neither starts new work nor joins another turn

cases.name: an admitted contribution remains admitted when its turn is stopped

steps.event: C targeting S is admitted as added-to-turn; its acknowledgement is lost
T with turn S is accepted
expect: ack T
one stopped result for S accounting for its effective request
no requirement to fulfill C after S is stopped

steps.event: an identical copy of C arrives
expect: normal duplicate acknowledgement
retain C's original admission disposition
no reapplication of C
no reopening of S

cases.name: stop may bypass an in-flight contribution or answer

steps.event: S is open; the requester has unacknowledged say C, either a contribution targeting S or an answer targeting S's question
the requester sends T with turn S
expect: T may be in flight beside C
at most one stop occupies the additional sending slot
T has its own identity and retry state
T targets S rather than C or the question

steps.event: ack T arrives while C's disposition is still unknown
expect: T is confirmed accepted
C is not acknowledged or withdrawn by ack T
C's sending slot remains held until its own disposition is known or it is explicitly released

cases.name: local withdrawal is scoped to the intended turn

steps.event: the sender has unsent contributions and answers known to belong to S, plus an unrelated queued fresh request N
the sender chooses to stop S
expect: withdraw unsent submissions known to belong to S
retain unrelated queued request N
already sent submissions retain their identities and delivery uncertainty
local withdrawal does not prove remote cancellation

steps.event: in a separate scenario the opening request S itself is still unsent when the sender withdraws S
expect: withdraw S locally so it is never sent
no remote stop is required to prevent this unsent request from starting

cases.name: a stopped turn does not prove global quiescence or rollback

steps.event: S has already initiated an external effect and a child actor's independent turn U
T with turn S is accepted and the actor sends S's stopped result
expect: the actor ceases advancing S
S cannot emit a later success or another terminal result
no claim that an already initiated external effect was undone
no automatic cancellation or terminal result for U
no promise that all descendants or external effects are quiescent

cases.name: application cancellation uses its own declared contract

steps.event: an earlier acceptance turn S returned application job J; J continues while another turn N is open
T with turn S arrives
expect: refusal nothing-to-stop for T
no inference that job J was canceled
N remains open

steps.event: an actor offers an authorized cancel_job operation declaring its target, effects, and result; the requester invokes it for J in a separate conversation
expect: the cancellation invocation has its own turn and response contract
its acknowledgement alone does not establish completed cancellation
its result is interpreted under the declared cancellation contract
job identity and cancellation scope remain application concepts

cases.name: stop does not determine what happened before context loss

steps.event: S may have executed in ended C1; properly established C2 has active guards but no S
A separately authorized new stop T signed for C2 with turn S is accepted
expect: ack T
prospective suppression applies only within retained C2
no reconstruction of C1 or its lost turn
no assertion that earlier work did not execute, was canceled or was undone

steps.event: C2's required state is also lost under keel.provisioned-context.v1
expect: invalidate its guard before further admission and close its connection
core requires no durable suppression across that loss
original C2 traffic is rejected by the retired guard or a fresh mismatching scope
same-scope retry needs an explicitly applicable stronger profile rather than a new connection alone

cases.name: an unauthorized stop establishes no suppression

steps.event: T with turn S is structurally valid and signed by the configured requester; its scope guard passes, but current action policy denies that requester authority to stop or suppress S
expect: refusal not-authorized for T
no stop of an open S
no suppression if S is still unknown
no authority inferred from knowledge of S's identity

cases.name: completion wins even when its result has not arrived

steps.event: S completes with terminal result R; all delivery attempts for R are lost
the requester still believes S is open and sends T with turn S
expect: refusal nothing-to-stop for T
R remains S's sole terminal result
no stopped result replaces R
nothing-to-stop does not disclose R's status or promise its recovery

cases.name: repeated prospective stops preserve one target without affecting another

steps.event: N is open; T with turn S was accepted while S is unseen
a different stop U with turn S arrives
expect: ack U
retain suppression of opening request S
no turn or result created for S
N remains open

steps.event: N closes; valid opening request S arrives
expect: ack S
taken for S as not-acted-on
S still cannot start work when the conversation becomes idle

cases.name: a stop beside an unrelated request preserves both delivery obligations

steps.event: S has closed; the requester has sent unrelated opening request N without receiving its acknowledgement
the requester sends T with turn S beside N; N arrives and opens its turn
expect: N's opening request is not withdrawn or suppressed by T

steps.event: ack N arrives while T remains unconfirmed
expect: later ordinary submissions remain held by T's sending slot

steps.event: T arrives and its refusal reaches the requester
expect: refusal nothing-to-stop for T
N remains open
both sending slots are resolved and ordinary delivery can continue

cases.name: acceptance and timeout have distinct meanings for stop

steps.event: the requester sends T with turn S and exhausts attempts without a reply
expect: T is not confirmed
no assertion that S has stopped
T may still arrive later and is still scoped to S

steps.event: within the retained context ack T later arrives but S's terminal notification is missing
expect: acceptance of T is known
ack T is not S's terminal result
no assertion of application cancellation, rollback, or descendant quiescence
